messages:
Maya: Heads up — I'm seeing ~200 inbound leads stuck in 'Unassigned' after enrichment-service restart at 06:12 UTC. HubSpot shows enrichment pending, Salesforce sync queued. Round-robin seems to have skipped a bunch. Anyone else?

deploy-bot: enrichment-service v2.1.8 restarted (ci/456) 2024-12-08T06:12:03Z

Ethan: yup, saw a spike in assign-failures around 06:12. KV cache flush on the enrich instances likely reset session IDs that the RR uses.

Priya: We're seeing 410 from the HubSpot webhook when enrichment is missing — retries go to backoff so assignment never gets the enriched owner. Happened before in canary.

Sam: Can we do a short fallback: if enrichment not present after 8s, route by raw lead source -> deterministic owner (geo fallback)? That should unblock leads until enrich finishes.

Alex: @Sam @Maya we can heat up a fallback in the router for 5m. Quick patch: check enrichment == null => route to `raw_owner` or to `round_robin_v2` that ignores session_id. I'll push a canary.

Maya: Sounds good. Also let's add a temporary alert on `assign-failures > 50/min` and run a one-off backfill to claim the unassigned leads.

Ethan: I'll push the router canary now (`git push origin hotfix/enrich-fallback`) and trigger a staged rollout to marketing namespace. Adding alert in PagerDuty.

Priya: Created HubSpot list `unassigned-after-enrich-1728394000` and starting a soft backfill via APIs. Will post progress here.

Sam: Thanks — after canary we should run a 10k sample to verify no double-assign. Also recommend a short-term change to webhook retry behaviour: immediate 3 retries, then handoff to dead-letter queue instead of indefinite backoff.

Alex: Canary up 06:38 UTC (1728394280). monitoring: assignment success rate improved from ~92% -> ~99% within 2 minutes. Rolling to 100% in 3 minutes. Will file a postmortem action item: make session rotation graceful and add compatibility layer so RR doesn't depend on ephemeral session IDs.

Maya: Great. Please follow up with a one-paragraph playbook note and a small doc for marketing ops on how to trigger backfill and what alerts to watch. @Alex please assign the follow-ups. :thumbsup:
